notes.text:
TL072 band-pass existing schematic edit:
- Changed C4 Value from 47n to 100nF; retained feedback capacitor C3=47n. Singular capacitor wording was interpreted as grounded low-pass capacitor C4; this is an assumption, not evaluator-confirmed.
- Added fresh Device:R R5=10k, default vertical orientation. At Z3.00 center (666,665), upper endpoint (666,627), lower endpoint (666,702). Wired upper pin to Vo2 (666,513); visible junction dot confirmed attachment.
- Added power:GND via chooser at lower pin (666,702), removing open-pin circle. Chooser OK (698,828).
- Home then Ctrl+S gave full-sheet view, no title star, and status path /home/cua/kicad_project/kicad_BandpassFilter_circuit/kicad_BandpassFilter_circuit.kicad_sch at step 23.
- Scroll zoom previously jumped to Z100; Home and F1 were usable recovery/navigation tools.
- Prior simple edits scored 1.00, while prior buck-filter additions scored 0.00 despite visual confidence. This task has no score yet; final connectivity is visually checked only.
